mapper.select:
SELECT cust_sq AS "custSq", cust_name AS "custName", cust_phone AS "custPhone" FROM tb_m1_info_customer
AND cust_name LIKE '%' || #{custName} || '%'
AND cust_phone LIKE '%' || #{custPhone} || '%'
ORDER BY cust_sq DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_m1_info_customer SET receive_consent = #{receiveConsent}, consent_dt = NOW() WHERE cust_phone = #{custPhone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_m1_label_print_history ( admin_no, cust_name, zipcode, addr, first_print_dt, last_print_dt, print_count ) VALUES ( #{admin_no}, #{cust_name}, #{zipcode}, #{addr}, NOW(), NOW(), 1 ) ON CONFLICT (admin_no) DO UPDATE SET cust_name = EXCLUDED.cust_name, zipcode = EXCLUDED.zipcode, addr = EXCLUDED.addr, last_print_dt = NOW(), print_count = tb_m1_label_print_history.print_count + 1
